purpose: Follow-up: isolate native prefill pool size at the selected eight decode threads after decode-only confirmation failed.
selection: Among answer-stable quality-passing configurations, prioritize complete qualification passes, then highest decode ratio, then lower latency. Freeze the selected pair before two independent confirmations.
success: Selected screening pair and both fresh confirmation pairs must independently pass unchanged production-rag-model-contribution-v6 and preserve the 16-thread outputs. Report >=0.85 throughput ratio separately as desirable margin, not a changed gate.
hypothesis: Eight native prefill workers may reduce SMT contention and remove 16-to-8 active-pool transitions. The previous experiment did not measure this setting.
controls: 16 declared workload/Java threads and 16 reference threads, eight native decode workers, same artifacts and sampling. Only native prefill/pool size changes between 16 and 8. Default smoke continues to use no tuning properties.
limitations: One catalog RAG corpus tests this admission gate; it is not a broad quality benchmark. RAG report records output text and token counts, not token IDs. One host cannot establish cross-host performance.

fleet.stopCondition: Exit on completion or error, terminate-on-shutdown, 150 minute hard shutdown
